reason: I already pay for magic apps, and a Hebrew one with the gallery, calculator and search reveals is something I don't have yet. I'd try the free tricks at home first, and if one of them fools my wife I'd pay the 99 before the next party.
objection: I'm not a magician, so if the reveal is clunky or I mess up the setup I'll look like an idiot in front of everyone. And I'm a bit wary of typing my card on a website for something installed from the browser and not the App Store.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks feel clumsy or obviously fake when I try them on a friend, I won't pay.
